title: Can Conventional ECG Technology Capture Fetal Cardiac Activity?
official: Can Conventional ECG Technology Capture Fetal Cardiac Activity?
summary: This is a feasibility study for a new application for capturing fetal cardiac activity. The objective of this study is to determine if it is feasible to capture a fetal ECG signal using a Holter ECG device. As comparison we will use a standard Doppler Fetal Heart Rate (FHR) device.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Singleton or twin pregnant women at 32 weeks gestation to full term after routine antepartum testing.

Exclusion Criteria:

* None.
